items.html: But the truth is that there are three couplings in the Shema, which are the third pregnancy of the externality, and they are Names of Elokim, and they are actual Mochin of the Elokim of Katnut, and they are the Gadlut of Katnut. And there is a first pregnancy of the Katnut of the internality, and there is the nursing of the internality.
